title: Looking for an AI site to create HD 2D-style game assets (not pixel art)
author: Forward-Ad-8456
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I’m developing a 2D game as a solo project.  
Right now, I’m using **pixel art assets** (some are purchased),

*Processing img eyhxeocgu6zf1...*

I’m **not trying to edit my existing images**,  
but rather looking for an **AI site that can create new 2D assets**  
— either by referencing my current ones or by generating from prompts.

Does anyone know a good **AI generator specialized for 2D game graphics web site**?

Thanks in advance 🙏

comments.author: beelllllll
comments.body:
Try my site https://www.autosprite.io/

It’s meant more for traditional characters but play with the “custom setting” and uncheck humanoid since you have like asteroids and such , and it can do a good job at that too.

Hope it helps!

replies.author: Forward-Ad-8456
replies.body: Thanks. let me check it out.

comments.author: mike402
comments.body: Ludo.ai is still the benchmark. You can try others but they’re not the same

replies.author: agarlington
replies.body: lol is Ludo your thing? ;) I just gave it a shot, it made a professional level freakin concept document for my first little 2D-JRPG project. Pretty darn neat, gonna play with it some more.

replies.author: mike402
replies.body: I'm part of the team yes. Reach out on Discord if you want, we have a pretty active community over there :)

comments.author: lordpoee
comments.body: Mage.space generate anything you want, free, unlimited. Then grab a background remover, eezy peezy

comments.author: Disastrous_Seesaw_51
comments.body:
Working on a free product which hopefully will be byo key, considering opensource. Dm me for beta access.

PS: should have mentioned it will build your navigation matrix. Not just... An image...

comments.author: Superb-Panda964
comments.body: Haven’t tried training actual game assets on it yet, but you might wanna look into the Forge tool on Fiddlart — it lets you train your own model from your art so the outputs match your style instead of looking generic. Could be worth a shot for keeping your 2D assets consistent.

comments.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
comments.body: Hey I saw your post now only, If you are still looking for non pixel art generator you can checkout pixelartgen.com . It has like 7-8 art style where you can choose from. If you couldn't find your requirements, definitely message me, I can add according to your requirements

replies.author: Forward-Ad-8456
replies.body: Thank you for your reply. Your site's name is pixelartgen.com 😀. Anyway I'll check it out. Thanks

replies.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
replies.body: Yeah that's true, Initially my plan was only for pixel art sprites😅. But now I am trying to expand it to all kinds
